sn22.117:1.2: idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī …pe… sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.117:1.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.117:1.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano rūpabandhanabandho sāntarabāhirabandhanabandho atīradassī apāradassī bandho jiyyati bandho miyyati bandho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.
sn22.117:1.5: vedanaṃ attato samanupassati …pe… vedanāya vā attānaṃ.
sn22.117:1.6: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano vedanābandhanabandho sāntarabāhirabandhanabandho atīradassī apāradassī bandho jiyyati bandho miyyati bandho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.
sn22.117:1.10: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano viññāṇabandhanabandho sāntarabāhirabandhanabandho atīradassī apāradassī bandho jiyyati bandho miyyati bandho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.
sn22.117:2.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī …pe… sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.117:2.2: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.117:2.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako narūpabandhanabandho nasāntarabāhirabandhanabandho tīradassī pāradassī parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi
sn22.117:2.8: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako naviññāṇabandhanabandho nasāntarabāhirabandhanabandho tīradassī pāradassī parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmīti.
